headlines.text: India’s ‘Cockroach’ leaders hold talks with gov’t as protests continue. Cockroach Janta Party protesters have stressed their demonstrations will continue until their demands have been met.

Secret Service agent on JD Vance's detail investigated for allegedly leaking operational security info. A Secret Service agent on JD Vance's protective division faces an administrative and potential criminal inquiry over compromising operational security.
